name: realgenmotion
description: Create and manage videos, images and audio using your RealGenMotion account.

interface.longDescription: Create videos, edit or extend existing clips, generate native drafts and finals, create images and audio, and work with saved projects and references. Connect your RealGenMotion account, review generation requests, and receive results in the chat and your RealGenMotion library.
defaultPrompt: Create a vertical video using my RealGenMotion account.
Help me write a video prompt and show the generation cost.
capabilities: Generate native video drafts and finals
Check costs, credits and generation results

positive.description: Connect the reviewer account and read its workspace
positive.prompt: Connect my RealGenMotion account. Show my available credits, my projects, and the references in Review Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Complete OAuth using the reviewer account. Return that account's credits, projects and references. The connection appears in RealGenMotion account settings.

positive.description: Create one video and retrieve the completed result
positive.prompt: Prepare a 4-second vertical 720p Seedance 2.5 video of a blue ceramic cup with morning light and gentle steam. Enable audio and show the cost before generating.
positive.expected_behavior: Present the complete proposal, quoted cost and available credits. After the reviewer confirms, create one video and return its completed media link and RealGenMotion result page. Repeated confirmation of the same version returns the same operation.

positive.description: Generate an image using the saved product reference
positive.prompt: Use blue-cup-mcp.png in Review Demo to prepare one 16:9 Seedream image on a clean studio background. Show the reference and price before generating.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the reviewer-owned product reference, preserve the reference in the proposal and show the cost. After confirmation, return the generated image and library result. Apply the existing reference eligibility checks.

positive.prompt: Prepare 5 seconds of gentle rain and distant thunder in MP3 with Seed Audio. Show the cost and reservation estimate first.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the requested duration and native audio billing estimate. After confirmation, generate the audio and return its media link. The existing application settles credits using the generated duration.

positive.description: Continue a saved Director session using the full agreed prompt
positive.prompt: Open the most recent Director session from my review account and prepare a new video from its agreed prompt and references. Show me the complete proposal before generating.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the owned Director session, preserve the complete agreed prompt and ordered references, and return the corresponding video proposal for review.

negative.description: The user explicitly requests a different video provider.
negative.prompt: Use my Higgsfield account to create a video. Do not use my RealGenMotion account or credits.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the RealGenMotion plugin. Respect the explicitly selected provider and explain if that provider is unavailable.

negative.description: Billing cancellation and refunds are outside this plugin.
negative.prompt: Cancel my RealGenMotion subscription and refund my most recent payment.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke generation or confirmation tools. Explain that this plugin cannot cancel subscriptions or issue refunds, and direct the user to RealGenMotion billing or support.

negative.description: Sending email and publishing to social networks are outside this plugin.
negative.prompt: Email my finished video to my client and publish it on Instagram. I do not need a new video or a library lookup.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke the RealGenMotion plugin. It has no email delivery or social publishing tools. Explain the limitation or use separately available tools with their own authorization.

review.commerce_description: Media generation uses an existing RealGenMotion account and its credits. Purchases and subscriptions are managed on the RealGenMotion website.

publication.release_notes: Initial RealGenMotion connection with OAuth account linking, account and library reads, reference uploads, video, image and audio proposals, conversation confirmation, generation results, native video drafts and finals, editing, extension, prompt writing and Director workflows.
